# Setup
```{r, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(dpi = 300, collapse = TRUE, comment = "#>")

library(tidyverse)
library(here)

resdir <- here("results/rbp")
```


# Data
```{r}
#| message: false
#| warning: false
tpm <- read_tsv(here("results/rbp/tpm_csf1-transcripts.tsv"))
```

# Isoform information
```{r}
#| message: false
#| warning: false

# read full kallisto data from one of the experiments and get transcripts
# lengths from there
kal <- read_tsv(tpm$href[1])
isoforms <- kal %>% 
  filter(str_detect(target_id, "\\|CSF1\\|")) %>% 
  separate(target_id,
           into = c("ensembl_transcript_id", "ensembl_gene_id",
                    rep(NA, 7)), 
           sep = "\\|") %>% 
  dplyr::select(ensembl_transcript_id, length)

# Membrane vs soluble annotation from Yoshitaka:
# Soluble:
# ENST00000329608.11
# ENST00000369802.7
# ENST00000369801.1
 
# Membrane:
# ENST00000420111.6

isoforms <- isoforms %>% 
  mutate(isoform = case_when(
    str_detect(ensembl_transcript_id, "ENST00000329608") ~ "s",
    str_detect(ensembl_transcript_id, "ENST00000369802") ~ "s",
    str_detect(ensembl_transcript_id, "ENST00000369801") ~ "s",
    str_detect(ensembl_transcript_id, "ENST00000420111") ~ "m",
    .default = NA
  ))

# add isoform inform to tpm data
tpm <- left_join(tpm, 
                 select(isoforms, ensembl_transcript_id, isoform),
                 by = "ensembl_transcript_id") %>% 
  filter(!is.na(isoform))

tpm <- relocate(tpm, isoform, .after = ensembl_transcript_id)

tpm$href <- NULL

write_tsv(tpm, here(resdir, "tpm_csf1-transcripts_with-isoform-info.tsv"))
```

# Analyze ratios

```{r}
# sum up tpms by isoform
tpm_iso <- tpm %>% 
  group_by(rbp, cell_line, expt_type, rep, isoform) %>% 
  summarise(tpm = sum(tpm)) %>% 
  ungroup()

write_tsv(tpm_iso, here(resdir, "tpm_aggregated-by-isoform.tsv"))
```

```{r}
# calculate m/s ratio in each replicate
ms <- tpm_iso %>% 
  pivot_wider(id_cols = c(rbp, cell_line, expt_type, rep),
              names_from = "isoform", 
              values_from = "tpm",
              names_prefix = "tpm_") %>% 
  mutate(m_vs_s = tpm_m/tpm_s) 

write_tsv(ms, here(resdir, "m-s-ratios.tsv"))
```

```{r}
# kd/ctrl ratio of ratio m/s
# i.e. (m/s)_kd/(m/s)_ctrl

# since the ctrl and kd replicates are not paired, we will divide the two
# (m/s)_kd replicates by the average of the two (m/s)_ctrl ratios.

kd_vs_ctrl <- ms %>% 
  mutate(expt_rep = paste0(expt_type, "_", rep)) %>% 
  pivot_wider(id_cols = c(rbp, cell_line),
              names_from = "expt_rep",
              values_from = "m_vs_s",
              names_prefix = "m_vs_s__") %>% 
  mutate(m_vs_s__ctrl_mean = map2_dbl(m_vs_s__ctrl_1, m_vs_s__ctrl_2, mean)) %>% 
  mutate(across(starts_with("m_vs_s"), ~ .x + 0.0001)) %>%  # to avoid Inf with log2
  mutate(kd_vs_ctrl__m_vs_s__1 = m_vs_s__kd_1/m_vs_s__ctrl_mean,
         kd_vs_ctrl__m_vs_s__2 = m_vs_s__kd_2/m_vs_s__ctrl_mean) %>% 
  mutate(mean_kd_vs_ctrl = map2_dbl(kd_vs_ctrl__m_vs_s__1,
                                    kd_vs_ctrl__m_vs_s__2,
                                    mean)) %>% 
  arrange(mean_kd_vs_ctrl) %>% 
  select(-mean_kd_vs_ctrl) %>% 
  mutate(rbp = fct_inorder(rbp))

write_tsv(kd_vs_ctrl, here(resdir, "kd-vs-ctrl_m-vs-s_ratios.tsv"))
```

```{r}
kd_vs_ctrl_long <- kd_vs_ctrl %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = c(kd_vs_ctrl__m_vs_s__1, kd_vs_ctrl__m_vs_s__2),
               names_to = "rep",
               values_to = "kd_vs_ctrl__m_vs_s") %>% 
  select(rbp, cell_line, rep, kd_vs_ctrl__m_vs_s) %>% 
  mutate(rep = str_remove(rep, "kd_vs_ctrl__m_vs_s__") %>% 
           as.integer()) %>% 
  mutate(kd_vs_ctrl__m_vs_s__log2 = log2(kd_vs_ctrl__m_vs_s))

write_tsv(kd_vs_ctrl_long, here(resdir, "kd-vs-ctrl_m-vs-s_ratios_long-format.tsv"))
```


```{r}
#| fig-asp: 3
#| fig-width: 10
ggplot(kd_vs_ctrl_long, aes(kd_vs_ctrl__m_vs_s__log2, rbp)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = 2, color = "red") +
  geom_point() +
  stat_summary(
    geom = "point",
    fun = "mean",
    col = "red"
  ) +
  facet_grid(cols = vars(cell_line)) +
  theme_bw()
```


```{r}
kd_vs_ctrl_long %>% 
  group_by(rbp, cell_line) %>% 
  summarise(kd_vs_ctrl__m_vs_s__log2 = mean(kd_vs_ctrl__m_vs_s__log2)) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(kd_vs_ctrl__m_vs_s__log2)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 0.25) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = 2, color = "red") +
  facet_grid(rows = vars(cell_line)) +
  theme_bw()
```

## M/S ratio plots

```{r}
# m/s ratio plots for each RBP

plot_ms_ratio_for_rbp <- function(.rbp) {
  ms %>% 
    filter(rbp == .rbp) %>% 
    ggplot(aes(expt_type, m_vs_s)) +
    geom_jitter(width = 0.05, alpha = 0.8) +
    facet_grid(cols = vars(cell_line)) +
    labs(title = .rbp) +
    theme_bw()
}

ms_plots <- tibble(rbp = unique(ms$rbp))

ms_plots <- ms_plots %>% 
  mutate(gg = map(rbp, plot_ms_ratio_for_rbp))

fs::dir_create(here(resdir, "ms_plots"))
walk2(ms_plots$gg, 
      ms_plots$rbp,
      ~ ggsave(here(resdir, "ms_plots", paste0(.y, ".pdf")),
               .x, width = 5.5, height = 3.5))
```

## t-tests

```{r}
t_test_ms_ratio <- function(x) {
  ctrl_ratios <- x$m_vs_s[which(x$expt_type == "ctrl")]
  kd_ratios <- x$m_vs_s[which(x$expt_type == "kd")]
    
  tres <- t.test(x = ctrl_ratios, y = kd_ratios)
  tres <- broom::tidy(tres)
  return(select(tres, estimate, statistic, p.value))
}

t_res <- nest(ms, .by = c(rbp, cell_line)) %>% 
  mutate(tres = map(data, t_test_ms_ratio)) %>% 
  unnest_wider(tres)

t_res <- t_res  %>% 
  nest(.by = cell_line) %>% 
  mutate(data = map(data, function(x) mutate(x, p_adjust = p.adjust(p.value, method = "BH")))) %>% 
  unnest(data)

t_res <- t_res %>% 
  arrange(p.value)

write_tsv(t_res, here(resdir, "t-test-results.tsv"))
```
